ItemID: unavailable; Title: A Fool To Care; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its rootsy blues sound fits my recent listening, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Every Great Motown Hit Remastered; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and roots rock than a Motown hits collection right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Slipstream; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Bonnie Raitt's bluesy style appeals to me, though I would only choose one album today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having recently listened to Old Sock, I would choose this for its relaxed blues sound and Eric Clapton connection.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Trouble No More: The Bootleg Series Vol. 13 / 1979-1981; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A collection focused on this particular Dylan period is more specialized than I want today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Definitive Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this collection matches my interests.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Ultimate O'Jays; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for a soul hits compilation on this visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: A Hard Day's Night; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am in the mood for rootsy, blues-oriented music rather than early Beatles pop.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Stranger To Stranger; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Paul Simon's songwriting interests me, but I would leave this for a more exploratory listening session.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Live at the Cellar Door; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Neil Young's intimate live songwriting appeals to me, but The Breeze is my stronger choice today.
